hypothesis: The unchanged native Chat strict-schema route can deliver a complete representative request; if incomplete, existing read-end metadata distinguishes EOF, network exception and local cancellation. It cannot identify the closing hop.

decisions.complete: Require useful schema-valid content, native completion, usage and cold-reloaded receipt; then admit a fresh Code qualification under the same authorized profile. This does not explain historical failures.
decisions.incomplete_eof: Retain the unresolved reservation, no partial application or repeat; ask route owner to correlate framing/closure.
decisions.network_exception: Retain reservation; report safe exception and timing, without assigning the closing hop.
decisions.local_cancellation: Use recorded source/deadline to establish or reject a local cause before any fix.
decisions.output_limit_or_invalid_schema: Separate protocol delivery from unusable result; no partial application or full Code qualification.
decisions.admission_failure: No inference; preserve exact refusal and continue independent Amazon analysis.

pre_dispatch_operator_error.cause: Mistyped seed ID in CLI arguments; exact-source loader rejected before constructing an independent request.
